script_text: Pause, Pisces! Venus is pulling your relationship axis into a startling reversal before the day settles. Venus is moving through Scorpio, opposing Pisces and activating your 7th House of partnerships, while the Sun sextiles that axis from Libra in your 8th House. Neptune, your Water-sign ruler, works from Aries in your 2nd House, where fog and idealism can distort money choices today. Singles should attract someone direct who values transparency, but avoid mistaking intensity for compatibility. If partnered, raise the concern before resentment builds behind the 7th-House opposition. In the 2nd House, review contracts and income expectations; Neptune can make a vague offer look richer than it is, so verify every figure. Unexpected gift: 8th-House leverage lets you renegotiate a contract or clear shared debt. Follow for tomorrow's reading and subscribe so you do not miss this week's Venus shift.
